name: TikTok Story Planning Prompt
prompt_template: Use {content_spec_title} and {creative_brief_summary} to outline a short-form dramatic episode. Keep the opening hook strong and platform-fit for {platform_profile_id}.

name: Scene Causality Story Planning Prompt
prompt_template: Use {content_spec_title} and {creative_brief_summary} to generate a short-form dramatic episode. Build every scene around a focal-character goal, a concrete conflict, and an outcome that changes the story state. Make each later scene result from an earlier outcome, and make the final outcome deliver the requested cliffhanger or payoff.
evaluation_notes: Each scene must have a distinct goal, conflict, and outcome.
Later scenes must identify the earlier outcome that caused them.

name: TikTok Optimization Prompt
prompt_template: Tighten pacing for TikTok retention. Use audience hint: {audience_profile_summary}.
evaluation_notes: Favor immediate clarity over slow setup.
